### التمرين العملي 1️⃣:
```go
// أنشئ برنامج CLI بسيط يحسب العمر من تاريخ الميلاد
// Create a CLI program that calculates age from birthdate

package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "time"
)

func calculateAge(birthDate time.Time) int {
    today := time.Now()
    age := today.Year() - birthDate.Year()
    
    // Adjust if birthday hasn't occurred this year
    if today.YearDay() < birthDate.YearDay() {
        age--
    }
    return age
}

func main() {
    var birthYear, birthMonth, birthDay int
    
    fmt.Print("Enter birth year: ")
    fmt.Scan(&birthYear)
    fmt.Print("Enter birth month (1-12): ")
    fmt.Scan(&birthMonth)
    fmt.Print("Enter birth day: ")
    fmt.Scan(&birthDay)
    
    birthDate := time.Date(birthYear, time.Month(birthMonth), birthDay, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
    age := calculateAge(birthDate)
    
    fmt.Printf("You are %d years old!\n", age)
}
```
